selection: Rank mean fold net return minus mean absolute drawdown, penalize each negative fold by5 percentage points. Reject any fold with drawdown below -20%; require at least15 fills total and at least3 positive folds.
test_rule: One selected frozen pipeline evaluated once on reserve. Previous first holdout is now development and not independent evidence for v4.
fallback_if_no_candidate: Do not open reserve if no configuration passes development screens. Need further data/model/execution research.
